request.description:
**Preview checkout** sebelum bayar.

Mengirimkan `address_id` untuk menghitung ongkos kirim.

**Request Body:**
```json
{
  "address_id": "uuid-alamat-pengiriman"
}
```

**Response:** Ringkasan checkout per vendor, termasuk:
- Daftar item beserta harga, qty, subtotal
- **Opsi ongkir** (`shipping_options`) per vendor — courier, service, cost, ETD
- Platform fee
- Alamat pengiriman

**Pre-condition:** Cart harus memiliki item.

**Buat pesanan** setelah preview.

Pilih kurir dan service per vendor, lalu submit.

**Request Body:**
```json
{
  "address_id": "uuid-alamat",
  "shipping_choices": [
    {
      "vendor_id": "uuid-vendor",
      "courier_code": "jne",
      "service": "REG"
    }
  ],
  "notes": "catatan opsional"
}
```

**Catatan:**
- `courier_code` dan `service` harus sesuai dengan opsi dari preview
- Ongkir dihitung ulang server-side (tidak dikirim dari client)
- Jika berhasil, akan membuat order + invoice Xendit

**Response:** Daftar order yang dibuat, masing-masing dengan:
- `order_id`, `order_no`
- `subtotal`, `shipping_fee`, `platform_fee`, `grand_total`
- `invoice_url` — link pembayaran Xendit
- `expires_at` — batas waktu bayar

Mengambil daftar status order yang tersedia. **Public endpoint** (tidak perlu token).

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "order statuses loaded",
  "data": ["pending_payment", "paid", "processing", "shipped", "received", "completed", "canceled", "refunded"]
}
```

Mengambil **semua pesanan** milik customer.

**Query Params:**
- `page` (int, default: 1) — halaman ke-n
- `limit` (int, default: 10) — jumlah per halaman
- `status` (string, optional) — filter status: `pending_payment`, `paid`, `processing`, `shipped`, `received`, `completed`, `canceled`

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "orders retrieved successfully",
  "data": [
    {
      "order_id": "uuid",
      "items": [
        {
          "product_name": "Sajadah Premium",
          "selected_variant": "Hijau - L",
          "image_url": "https://storage.example.com/products/sajadah.jpg",
          "qty": 2,
          "unit_price": 150000
        }
      ],
      "total_payment": 320000,
      "order_date": "2026-03-11T10:00:00Z",
      "status": "processing"
    }
  ],
  "meta": {
    "page": 1,
    "limit": 10,
    "total_items": 5,
    "total_pages": 1
  }
}
```
Filter pesanan: **Belum Dibayar** (status `pending_payment`).
Filter pesanan: **Dikemas** (status `processing`).
Filter pesanan: **Dikirim** (status `shipped`).
Filter pesanan: **Sampai/Diterima** (status `received`). Customer bisa klik "Pesanan Diterima" untuk menyelesaikan pesanan.
Filter pesanan: **Selesai** (status `completed`).
Filter pesanan: **Dibatalkan** (status `canceled`).

request.description:
Mengambil **detail lengkap** satu pesanan customer.

**Auto-receive:** Jika status order `shipped` dan kurir mengonfirmasi delivered, order otomatis diupdate ke `received`.

**Response Structure:**
```json
{
  "shipping": {
    "courier": "J&T Express",
    "tracking_number": "JT272936382",
    "status": "Paket telah diterima",
    "status_date": "2026-03-15 14:00"
  },
  "address": {
    "name": "John Doe",
    "phone": "08123456789",
    "street": "Jl. Merdeka No. 1",
    "district": "Menteng",
    "city": "Jakarta Pusat",
    "province": "DKI Jakarta",
    "postal_code": "10110"
  },
  "store": {
    "vendor_id": "uuid",
    "name": "Toko Umroh"
  },
  "items": [
    {
      "name": "Sajadah Premium",
      "variant": "Hijau - L",
      "image_url": "https://storage.example.com/products/sajadah.jpg",
      "price": 150000,
      "qty": 2,
      "subtotal": 300000
    }
  ],
  "payment": {
    "method": "QRIS",
    "invoice_id": "INV-ODR-242727"
  },
  "order": {
    "order_no": "ORD-20260311-XXXX",
    "order_time": "2026-03-11T10:00:00Z",
    "payment_time": "2026-03-11T10:05:00Z",
    "shipping_time": "2026-03-12T08:00:00Z",
    "delivered_time": "2026-03-15T14:00:00Z"
  },
  "summary": {
    "subtotal": 300000,
    "shipping_fee": 8000,
    "service_fee": 12000,
    "grand_total": 320000
  },
  "actions": {
    "can_cancel": false,
    "can_complete": true,
    "can_review": false,
    "can_contact": true
  }
}
```

**Actions Logic:**
- `can_cancel`: true jika status `pending_payment`, `paid`, atau `processing`
- `can_complete`: true jika status `received`
- `can_review`: true jika status `completed`
- `can_contact`: true kecuali status `pending_payment` atau `canceled`

**Menyelesaikan pesanan** — customer mengonfirmasi telah menerima barang.

**Pre-condition:** Order harus berstatus `received`.

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "order completed successfully",
  "data": {
    "order_id": "uuid",
    "order_status": "completed",
    "payment_status": "paid",
    "completed_at": "2026-03-16T10:00:00Z"
  }
}
```

**Note:** Jika customer tidak mengklik tombol ini, order akan otomatis completed setelah 3 hari (via scheduler).

**Membatalkan pesanan** — customer membatalkan order.

**Pre-condition:** Order harus berstatus `pending_payment`, `paid`, atau `processing`.

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "order canceled successfully",
  "data": {
    "order_id": "uuid",
    "order_status": "canceled",
    "canceled_at": "2026-03-11T12:00:00Z"
  }
}
```

**Note:** Stok produk akan otomatis dikembalikan setelah pembatalan.

request.description:
Upload file langsung ke S3 menggunakan presigned URL.

**Langkah:**
1. Pastikan sudah menjalankan **Presign Ticket Attachment** → `ticket_upload_url` tersimpan otomatis

request.description:
Buat tiket baru. Customer harus login.

**Body:**
- `order_number` (string, required) — nomor pesanan terkait
- `phone` (string, required) — nomor HP yang bisa dihubungi
- `reporter_name` (string, required) — nama pelapor
- `subject_id` (int, required, min=1) — ID subject dari List Subjects
- `detail` (string, required) — deskripsi masalah
- `source` (string, required) — `app` atau `web`
- `attachment_key` (string, required) — object key dari Presign Attachment

**Flow:**
1. Login → simpan token
2. List Subjects → pilih `subject_id`
3. Presign Attachment → upload ke S3 → dapat `object_key`
4. Create Ticket → gunakan `object_key` sebagai `attachment_key`

**Auth:** Bearer Token (Role: customer)
